properties.description: Identifies successful Uniqkey sign-ins (browser extension, mobile, web or desktop) originating from an IP address that has not been observed for that user during the trailing 14 days. A new source address can indicate session hijacking or use of stolen master credentials, particularly when combined with an unusual client system. Uniqkey audits successful authentications only, so pair this rule with identity-provider telemetry if failed sign-in coverage is required.
properties.name: Uniqkey - Sign-in from unfamiliar IP address
